The signed-in user. The web client also probes it to learn whether another tab has
already refreshed the session, before it spends the refresh token (ADR 0029).

post.description:
Rotates the refresh token. Presenting an already-rotated token means it was stolen
(or replayed), so every session of that user is revoked.

get.description:
`snapshot` (the run's state now), then `attempt` and `status` events until the run
ends. Authenticated like any request, or with `?token=` from `POST
/runs/{id}/stream-token` where the browser can't send the session cookie.

A portable record of the run, recomputed from the persisted attempts via core's own
`finalize_run` (ADR 0018): the strongest guarantee it agrees with core's statistics.
`format=html` is one self-contained, fully escaped file (no external assets).

The baseline of suite `suite` (by name) for a registered `agent` (by name) or an

AgentResponse.title: AgentResponse
AgentResponse.description:
One call to the agent under test. A failed call (after retries) has `error` set, an
`ErrorStep` in `steps` and an empty `output`; adapters return it rather than raising.

AgentTestDraft.title: AgentTestDraft
AgentTestDraft.description:
A not-yet-saved config, probed once and never persisted or logged (same validation as
a real agent, since it's the same `AgentConfig`/`AuthHeader` types).

AgentTestOut.title: AgentTestOut
AgentTestOut.description:
`message` is the adapter's own sanitized text: it never includes a resolved address
(ADR 0012's SSRF guard keeps that out of user-facing errors) and is safe to show as-is.

AttemptResult.title: AttemptResult
AttemptResult.description:
One attempt of one case: the trace (`response`), every judge verdict and the
accounting. `status` is `error` whenever `error` is set.

HttpAgentConfig.title: HttpAgentConfig
HttpAgentConfig.description: The HTTP adapter's own config (ADR 0012), so what's stored is what the adapter runs.

McpAgentConfig.title: McpAgentConfig
McpAgentConfig.description:
The MCP adapter's own HTTP-transport config (ADR 0023), so what's stored is what the
adapter runs. `transport` is fixed to `"http"`: `McpHttpConfig` has no stdio fields at
all, so a stored `transport: "stdio"` config is a plain 422, not a runtime check.

ResponseMapping.title: ResponseMapping
ResponseMapping.description: JSONPath expressions into the agent's JSON response.

RunListOut.title: RunListOut
RunListOut.description:
A run as shown in a project's run history (overview trends, latest-runs table).
`agent_name` is the agent's current name for a registered agent, or the name an
unregistered/CI-pushed run recorded for itself (ADR 0020) — whichever applies.
`mean_latency_ms` isn't a stored column: it's the attempts-weighted average of
`run_case_summaries.mean_latency_ms` across the run's cases, computed at read time.

SuiteIssue.title: SuiteIssue
SuiteIssue.description:
One problem in a suite YAML file. `line`/`col` (1-indexed) are set whenever a source
position could be resolved: always for YAML syntax errors, best-effort for schema
violations (located by walking the composed node tree against the error's field path).
`path` is the dotted/bracketed pydantic field path, set only for schema violations.

TokenUsage.title: TokenUsage
TokenUsage.description: The agent's own token usage, as it reports it. None: not reported.
